description: Minimal Calendar Widget A Minimal Calendar Widget that's always on current date Features: * Contains no ads or payments * Two formats: Month and Week (resizable with initial respective values of 3x2 and 3x1) * Displays all events from your calendars with a symbol set (high number becomes generic) * Native widget configuration access or press widget’s top right corner * Pressing on any other part of the widget opens calendar application * Highly configurable per widget: start day of the week, theme, symbol set, symbol set colour, transparency, text size, show week number...
